title: ULA's Vulcan rocket failed ~10 minutes after liftoff from SLC-41, Cape Canaveral, on 15 Nov 2026 (17:40 UTC, 11:10 pm IST), losing all 40 Amazon Leo satellites (mission LV-01); first total mission failure in ULA's 20-year history; cause not yet known (ULA). First of 38 Vulcan launches Amazon booked; Vulcan to carry close to half of Leo's first-gen constellation; under 400 Leo satellites in orbit of 3,000+ planned; Amazon still plans initial service this year. India: Amazon first applied for a satcom licence in Oct 2023 and has none; Starlink, OneWeb, Jio Satellite hold GMPCS licences but none has started commercial service (security clearance, spectrum pricing pending).
headline: 40 Amazon Leo Satellites Lost as Vulcan Rocket Fails
